result.title: Raysemble: Metric 3D Bone Reconstruction from a Single X-ray
result.summary: Raysemble reconstructs eight lumbar and pelvic bones from a single X-ray by separating shape and placement. Each 3D query samples regional and global features at its image projection. A shared decoder predicts normalized bone shapes. Predicted depth and camera geometry determine 3D centers and scales for resampling these shapes onto a common grid in millimeters. Evaluation uses 23 held-out patients with 43 CT scans, each generating one simulated anteroposterior radiograph. Without rigid alignment to CT,Raysemble leads 15 evaluated methods, averaging 65.24% Dice, 9.09 mm HD95, and 3.32 mm ASSD over three random seeds. With identical inputs, it improves Dice over VolumeNeRF by 5.86 percentage points.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作从单张X光片重建八块腰椎与骨盆骨骼，将形状与位置分离：每个 3D 查询点在图像投影处采样局部与全局特征，由共享解码器预测归一化骨形，再用预测深度与相机几何确定中心与尺度并重采样到毫米网格。
AI.relevance_reason: 「按投影位置采样图像特征并解耦形状与位姿」的查询式几何表示，可能为 LVR 中潜状态如何按空间位置筛选视觉证据、保持几何信息提供可供核查的方法线索，但任务本身并非推理研究。
